title: Decide zoom semantics on mock canvases
notes: From study-tasks.json zoom-scales-grid-not-artwork. Zoom changes grid density but artwork stays the same size, so the readout can say 260 percent while the hero card renders at 1x. Honest fix: scale artwork by --zoom and counter-scale selection chrome by 1/--zoom. This changes what zoom means on every editor page: open a UX decision before implementing.
acceptance: A UX decision is opened (and resolved) on whether zoom scales artwork or only grid density
The chosen behavior is implemented in the shared canvas component and verified on at least 3 editor pages at zoom 0.5/1/2 with constant-size selection chrome if artwork scaling is chosen
